title: He quizzed me in a jacket I sold him

hooks.text: He quizzed me on underground rap, wearing a jacket I *sold* him.
POV: a guy quizzes you on underground rap in your own jacket.
The guy who gatekept me was wearing my old jacket.
A guy made me name three unreleased songs to prove I'm real.
He offered me $4 for a jacket he called archive.
A guy at the show tried to quiz me. Wrong girl.

hookVariants.visual: frame 0: the show (club light), a two-shot at eye level: the gatekeeper mid-point at Tiff, a dashed tomato cutout outline already pulsing around his jacket, Tiff deadpan; text hook 'he's wearing my jacket' in the top band
frame 0: tight on the gatekeeper's jacket and pointing hand with the dashed outline; the camera pulls back to the two-shot by 'jacket'; same text hook
frame 0: Tiff's MCU deadpan with his pointing finger entering from screen left; a whip to the two-shot on 'jacket'; same text hook

beats.text: He quizzed me on underground rap, wearing a jacket I *sold* him.
beats.visual: The show, club light, crowd bouncing behind. Two-shot: the gatekeeper (fur trapper, leather jacket) points in Tiff's face; a dashed tomato cutout outline pulses around his jacket; Tiff deadpan. Text hook 'he's wearing my jacket' from frame 0. Slow push.

beats.speaker: gatekeeper
beats.text: Name three *unreleased* songs, or you're a larper.
beats.visual: MCU on the gatekeeper, smug, talking, finger up counting; a speech bubble 'name 3 unreleased' pops on 'unreleased'.

beats.text: So I name four, with the *leak dates*, before he blinks.
beats.visual: Whip to Tiff's MCU, unimpressed; four lowercase tags pop around her one per beat: 'leak · 03.14', 'snippet · 05.02', 'demo · 06.30', 'the deleted one · 08.09'; on 'blinks' cut to his frozen shocked face.

beats.speaker: gatekeeper
beats.text: Okay, but that fit is probably *reps*.
beats.visual: Full shot at eye level: he squints at her with a magnifier like a legit check; a red 'LC?' tag hovers by her (never a leg or body close-up).

beats.text: It's retail. I keep receipts like a *tax office*.
beats.visual: Tiff MCU, smug; a stack of receipts unrolls down the frame beside her; a 'retail' tag pops.

beats.speaker: gatekeeper
beats.text: This jacket is real *archive*. You wouldn't know.
beats.visual: He strikes a pose (hands on hips), chin up; a gold 'ARCHIVE' tag sparkles on his jacket.

beats.text: Except I know that jacket. It lived on my *chair*.
beats.visual: Push in on the jacket; the dashed cutout outline locks onto it; on 'chair' a flash and the jacket's outline lands on top of Tiff's clothes chair at home.

beats.text: I listed it last month: mall brand, worn twice, *$40*.
beats.visual: Tiff's bedroom (plum walls, the chair buried in clothes, the jacket on top). A plain listing card pops: 'faux leather jacket · mall brand · worn twice' $40.

beats.text: He offered *$4* first, then paid the full $40.
beats.visual: A DM thread slides up: 'would u do $4' / 'no' / 'ok fine $40'; the listing card gets a SOLD stamp on the second '$40'.

beats.text: I tell him: that's not archive. That's my *chair*.
beats.visual: Back at the show: Tiff MCU, deadpan, leaning in; on 'chair' cut to the two-shot: his face drops (shocked), the crowd behind turns to look.

beats.speaker: gatekeeper
beats.text: Cool. Would you do *$30* for the boots?
beats.visual: His MCU with a nervous smile, already holding up his phone; a speech bubble '$30 for the boots?' pops.

beats.text: Back home, I snap the chair. *Listed.*
beats.visual: Tiff's bedroom at night, medium shot: she raises her phone at the clothes chair; the relist snap: viewfinder corners close on the chair, shutter flash on 'snap', the deadpan 'listed.' stamp on 'Listed'.

beats.text: *pileGo!* puts the whole chair live on five apps.
beats.visual: The pileGo! phone slides up: real cutouts, drafts, 'Live on 5', one sells, 'down everywhere else'; behind it pieces hop off the chair one by one; a small pileGo! bug top-left.

beats.text: So: $30 for the boots. Accept, counter, or *block*?
beats.visual: Tiff MCU on her bed, unimpressed, phone in hand; three choice tags 'accept / counter / block' pop on their words; then the pileGo! end card.
